    if size <= 0:
        raise ValueError("empty resource")
    
    # Check unit prefix

        raise ValueError(f"wrong units: {header!r}")

    # Reject multiple ranges (comma)

    first_str, last_str = parts

        if not s:

            v = int(s)
        except ValueError:
            raise ValueError(f"malformed range: non-numeric {name}={s!r}")
        if v < 0:
            raise ValueError(f"negative value for {name}: {v}")

    end = to_int(last_str, "end")
